title: Performance SLO Table and Bench
description: The service level objectives of the build system (hot-cache latency, edit to rebuild, cache hit rate, graph, memory, concurrency), the probes that measure them on a disposable checkout copy behind the tool-neutral interface, and the report and regression comparison of `repo bench`; every build implementation is held to the same table.
